items.t: Supports freezing property taxes in Georgia (2026).
items.q: As Governor, Rick will fight to make Georgia the most affordable state in America by freezing property taxes, cutting the state income tax, eliminating wasteful spending, and raising standards in government and education.

label: Written by AI from public sources — may contain errors.
bio: Rick Jackson grew up in poverty, moving through five foster homes and thirteen schools and spending part of his childhood in Atlanta’s Techwood Homes. He never knew his father, and his mother struggled with alcoholism.
